01 / About SVI

Electrical infrastructure, built around your operation.

SVI Control Panel (Siddhi Vinayak Industries) is an Ahmedabad-based manufacturer of electrical control and power panels for industrial and commercial applications.

With sheet-metal fabrication and powder coating under our own roof, we take ownership of the complete build — so customers get dependable power distribution, control, protection and automation from a single accountable supplier.

Built with proven components.

Switchgear and control parts are chosen to suit your application, your specification or your consultant's approved make list.

  • Air circuit breakersIncomer protection for high-current supplies
  • MCCBsFeeder protection with adjustable trip settings
  • MCBs & RCCBsFinal-circuit and earth-leakage protection
  • Contactors & overload relaysMotor switching and overload protection
  • Protection relaysOvercurrent and earth-fault detection
  • PLCs & HMIsAutomation logic and operator screens
  • MetersEnergy, power and current monitoring
  • Copper busbarsPower distribution inside the panel

06 / FAQ

Questions buyers ask.

Something else? Ask us directly.

What do you need from us to prepare a quotation?

A short description is enough to start: the application, the load or number of motors and feeders, the supply details, your site location and when you need the panel. Single-line diagrams, BOQs or specifications help us quote faster; send them by email or WhatsApp after your first enquiry.

Can you build to our specification and approved makes?

Yes. Every panel is designed around your application, and components can follow your specification or your consultant's approved make list.

How long does a panel take to manufacture?

It depends on the size and design of the panel and on component availability. We confirm the delivery schedule with each quotation.

Are panels tested before dispatch?

Yes. Each panel goes through electrical and functional checks before it leaves our workshop. If you need to inspect the panel at our facility, mention it with your enquiry.

Do you install and commission panels on site?

Yes, when required. We handle installation, commissioning, retrofitting and after-sales support.

Can you modify or upgrade an existing panel?

Yes. Send photos and details of the existing panel and what needs to change, and we will advise on a retrofit.

What warranty do you offer?

Warranty terms are stated in each quotation.

Where are you located?

Our facility is at Ved Bhoomi Industrial Estate, Bakrol–Bujrang, Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Tell us your site location and we will confirm delivery and site support.
